# Checkout blocks

Larger pieces of a checkout, each usable without the rest. They take their data as props and read wording and currency from `CheckoutProvider` (in `CheckoutProvider.tsx` in this folder), falling back to English and US dollars.

| Component | What it is |
|---|---|
| [CheckoutLayout, CheckoutHeader](CheckoutLayout) | The page shell. |
| [CheckoutSkeleton, OrderSummarySkeleton](CheckoutSkeleton) | What the page shows while it loads. |
| [ExpressCheckout](ExpressCheckout) | A row of wallet buttons above the form with an “OR” line under it. |
| [ContactField](ContactField) | One field for an email or a mobile number. |
| [AddressForm](AddressForm) | Address fields that follow the country. |
| [AddressAutocomplete](AddressAutocomplete) | The address line with lookup. |
| [ShippingMethods](ShippingMethods) | The shipping method block in its four states: a grey box asking for the address, a skeleton while rates load, a grey box when the address cannot be shipped to, and the list of rates. |
| [PickupLocations](PickupLocations) | What the Delivery section shows for Pick up: a heading, how many stores have stock, and a choice list with each store’s address, readiness and distance. |
| [PaymentMethods](PaymentMethods) | Payment methods as a choice list with panels. |
| [CardFields, CardBrandBadges](CardFields) | Card number, expiry, security code and name, formatted as typed: groups of four (4-6-5 for American Express), `MM / YY` with a leading zero added, digits only. |
| [OrderSummary, OrderSummaryToggle](OrderSummary) | The grey column’s content: products, the discount field and the totals. |
| [LineItem, Totals, DiscountField](OrderSummary) | The order summary’s three parts, each usable alone. |
| [PolicyLinks](PolicyLinks) | The footer’s row of links. |
| [ConfirmationCheck](ConfirmationCheck) | The order-confirmed icon. |
| [ConfirmationCode](ConfirmationCode) | Text whose characters appear one at a time, 13ms apart, each rising half a line and settling with a slight overshoot. |
| [MapCard](MapCard) | A 180px stylised map for the top of the confirmation card. |
| [OrderDetails, ThankYou](ThankYou) | `ThankYou` is the confirmation page: tick, code and heading, the map card, the order details and a way onward, rising in 90ms apart. |
| [Checkout](Checkout) | Everything assembled into the page: layout, form, order summary, and the thank-you page it turns into. |
| [OrderDetails](OrderDetails) | Shared by other components; see its README. |
